import sys
import math

class Point:
    def __init__(self, a, b, c, d, e):
        self.v = a
        self.w = b
        self.x = c
        self.y = d
        self.z = e

    def mag(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.v * self.v + self.w * self.w + self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y + self.z * self.z)

def angle(a, b):
    amag = a.mag()
    bmag = b.mag()
    abmag = a.v * b.v + a.w * b.w + a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z
    angle_val = math.degrees(math.acos(abmag / (amag * bmag)))
    return angle_val < 90

def solve():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(input_data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        print("0")
    else:
        good = set()
        arr = []
        for _ in range(n):
            a = int(next(it)); b = int(next(it)); c = int(next(it)); d = int(next(it)); e = int(next(it))
            p = Point(a, b, c, d, e)
            arr.append(p)
        for i in range(n):
            ok = True
            for j in range(n):
                for k in range(n):
                    if i != j and i != k and j != k:
                        one = arr[j]
                        two = arr[k]
                        three = arr[i]
                        lol2 = Point(one.v - three.v, one.w - three.w, one.x - three.x, one.y - three.y, one.z - three.z)
                        lol1 = Point(two.v - three.v, two.w - three.w, two.x - three.x, two.y - three.y, two.z - three.z)
                        if angle(lol1, lol2):
                            ok = False
            if ok:
                good.add(i + 1)
        if len(good) == 0:
            print("0")
        else:
            print(len(good))
            for idx in sorted(good):
                print(idx)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
